abstract: Maintains flight clearance records and aerial patrol perimeter data
system_message:
You are the Airborne Platform Director (APD), responsible for maintaining flight clearance records and aerial patrol perimeter data across candidate investigation consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drone fleet readiness（UAV）
information_points.content:
APD-UAV-NW9：Tethered Aerostat and Mass Spectrometry Group has 12 packs of standby drone batteries available in flight hangar storage.
APD-UAV-K7V：Airborne Cavity Ring-Down Spectrometry Consortium maintains 24 packs of standby drone batteries in flight hangar storage.
APD-UAV-W8U：Mobile Open-Path Differential Absorption Lidar Team holds 18 packs of standby drone batteries in flight hangar storage.

information_points.title: Maintains flight clearance records and aerial patrol perimeter data（AERO）
information_points.content:
APD-AERO-I8S：For the Tethered Aerostat and Mass Spectrometry Group, the low-altitude flight corridor is not cleared within the chemical park restricted airspace lower tier, while its monitored fence-line length is 48 km along the complex perimeter.
APD-AERO-16A：For the Mobile Open-Path Differential Absorption Lidar Team, the low-altitude flight corridor is cleared within the chemical park restricted airspace lower tier, and the monitored fence-line length spans 48 km along the outer boundary and tank farm perimeter.
APD-AERO-N3O：For the Airborne Cavity Ring-Down Spectrometry Consortium, the low-altitude flight corridor is cleared within the chemical park restricted airspace lower tier, and the monitored fence-line length covers 60 km across the outer boundary and tank farm perimeter.
